name: spfx-wasm-samples-wasm-change-radar
title: SharePoint Change Radar
shortDescription: Review local or bounded current-site references before changing a SharePoint page or URL.
longDescription: Targets SPFx 1.24.0; current packages remain pinned to published stable SPFx 1.23.2 because 1.24.0 is not published. Uses a native TypeScript graph oracle in a dedicated worker; demo mode is deterministic and read-only.
